classified_object.notes: Research/engineering contest; robots are performing agents during play.

performance_agency.summary: During match play robots act autonomously; human contribution is primarily prior design/engineering.

performance_interface.summary: No human embodied performance interface during play; handlers are restricted service roles.

embodied_performance.summary: No human embodied performance interface during play; handlers are restricted service roles. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Physical field with robot perception/computation stacks.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Onboard sensing and game-control systems coordinate match state.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Technical and league rules bound platform conditions.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Human referees and game controllers govern the field.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Robot and human safety procedures apply at the venue.

sensing_tracking.summary: Onboard sensing is the robots' perception channel; game controller systems support officiation.

measurement.summary: Goals, cards, and match records under competition rules.

comparability.summary: Heterogeneous robots across teams except standard-platform leagues.

officiation.summary: Human referees and game controller infrastructure.

outcome_openness.summary: Match outcomes open among robot policies/hardware under rules.

consequence_structure.summary: Competition ranking and research prestige; not athletic human stakes.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Operational physical/computational robot space exists, but without live human athletic performance Spatial Sport does not attach.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Negative control: competitive outcome without live human performance agency.

content: Rule sets restoring live human teleoperation as decisive in-match skill channel.
An explicit Altis subclass for autonomous spectacles that does not claim sport invariants.

record.provenance_note: Per-field claim_class and status preserved verbatim from the source case. source_provisional_finding is the corpus's own attributed reading, not a new Atlas verdict. Provider claims live in evidence_sources; Altis interpretation carries C4/C5.
